columns.comment: Credit facility id (FAC-nnnnnn).
columns.name: facility_id

columns.comment: Credit-system obligor id (CRD-nnnnnn) the facility is booked to.
columns.name: obligor_id

columns.comment: Current dim_client version of the borrower (current snapshot; join to gold.dim_client).
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Snapshot date of the terms and balances (30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: as_of_date

columns.comment: Facility type: Term Loan, Revolving Credit Facility (RCF), Syndicated Loan, Bilateral Loan, Overdraft or Trade Loan.
columns.name: facility_type

columns.comment: Product key of the facility type; join to gold.dim_product (business line Lending / Transaction Banking).
columns.name: product_id

columns.comment: Facility status: Active, Matured or Prepaid.
columns.name: facility_status

columns.comment: True for facilities active at the as-of date (the live credit book).
columns.name: is_active

columns.comment: Facility currency (ISO 4217).
columns.name: currency

columns.comment: Committed facility limit in USD (terms).
columns.name: limit_usd

columns.comment: Drawn (outstanding) balance at the as-of month-end in USD - the current funded exposure; 0 when no longer outstanding.
columns.name: drawn_usd

columns.comment: Drawn balance at the as-of month-end in facility currency.
columns.name: drawn_lcy

columns.comment: Undrawn commitment (limit - drawn, floored at 0) for active facilities, USD; 0 otherwise.
columns.name: undrawn_usd

columns.comment: Drawn / limit at the as-of month-end as a fraction (0.95 = 95%).
columns.name: utilisation_pct

columns.comment: Last month-end with a balance record for the facility (shows when a matured facility was last outstanding).
columns.name: last_balance_date

columns.comment: Lending margin over the base rate in basis points (weight by limit for a portfolio average: SUM(margin_bps * limit_usd) / SUM(limit_usd)).
columns.name: margin_bps

columns.comment: Facility origination / signing date.
columns.name: origination_date

columns.comment: Contractual final maturity date.
columns.name: maturity_date

columns.comment: Date the facility was closed early (prepaid / refinanced); null otherwise.
columns.name: closed_date

columns.comment: Days from the as-of date to maturity for active facilities (null otherwise).
columns.name: days_to_maturity

columns.comment: Remaining tenor in years for active facilities.
columns.name: remaining_tenor_years

columns.comment: True for active facilities maturing within 12 months of the as-of date (refinancing window).
columns.name: matures_within_12m

columns.comment: Security: Unsecured, Cash, Receivables, Inventory, Fixed Assets or Real Estate.
columns.name: security_type

columns.comment: True when the facility is secured (security_type other than Unsecured).
columns.name: is_secured

columns.comment: Credit support: Parent Guarantee, Keepwell (parent keepwell / comfort letter), Corporate Guarantee, Sponsor Support or None.
columns.name: guarantor_type

columns.comment: True when the facility relies on the parent: guarantor_type Parent Guarantee or Keepwell.
columns.name: has_parent_support

columns.comment: True when the facility carries financial covenants.
columns.name: has_covenant

columns.comment: Comma-separated covenants tested on the facility (e.g. ICR, Net Debt/EBITDA); null = none.
columns.name: covenant_types

columns.comment: Number of distinct financial covenants tested.
columns.name: n_covenants

columns.comment: Date of the facility's latest covenant test on or before the as-of date.
columns.name: last_test_date

columns.comment: Lowest covenant headroom at the latest test across the facility's covenants, as a fraction (0.08 = 8%; negative = breached).
columns.name: min_headroom_latest

columns.comment: Headroom of the leverage covenant (Net Debt/EBITDA) at its latest test (fraction; negative = breached).
columns.name: leverage_headroom_latest

columns.comment: Net Debt/EBITDA actual at the latest leverage test (x).
columns.name: leverage_actual_latest

columns.comment: Maximum Net Debt/EBITDA allowed by the leverage covenant at the latest test (x).
columns.name: leverage_threshold_latest

columns.comment: True when any covenant was breached at its latest test.
columns.name: covenant_breached_latest

columns.comment: Covenant tests of the facility with a waiver granted (all history).
columns.name: n_covenant_waivers

columns.comment: True when a covenant waiver was granted on a test in the current fiscal year (FY2026, from 1-Apr-2026).
columns.name: has_waiver_current_fy

columns.comment: Collateral items pledged to the facility.
columns.name: n_collateral

columns.comment: Appraised value of the pledged collateral in USD (latest valuation).
columns.name: collateral_value_usd

columns.comment: Highest loan-to-value of the facility's collateral items as a fraction (0.72 = 72%).
columns.name: max_ltv_pct

columns.comment: Oldest last-valuation date among the facility's collateral items.
columns.name: oldest_valuation_date

columns.comment: Support letter in the JP share (JPSL-...) backing the facility: the parent guarantee covering it, or the subsidiary's keepwell; null when not parent-supported or not found.
columns.name: jp_support_letter_id

columns.comment: Status of that support letter: Active, Expired or Released.
columns.name: jp_support_letter_status

columns.comment: Date the parent last confirmed the support letter.
columns.name: jp_support_last_confirmed_date

columns.comment: Amount of parent support stated in the letter, USD.
columns.name: jp_support_amount_usd

columns.comment: Japanese parent (JPP-nnnn) providing the guarantee / keepwell (parent-supported facilities only).
columns.name: jp_parent_id

columns.comment: Japanese parent's internal grade (1 best .. 10) in force at the as-of date, from the Tokyo HO rating share; parent-supported facilities only.
columns.name: parent_rating_grade

columns.comment: External-scale equivalent of the parent's rating (e.g. AA, A+) from the JP share - the 'parent external rating'.
columns.name: parent_rating_equivalent

columns.comment: Outlook of the parent rating: Positive, Stable or Negative.
columns.name: parent_rating_outlook

columns.comment: Latest parent rating action: Initial, Affirm, Upgrade or Downgrade.
columns.name: parent_rating_last_action

columns.comment: Date of the latest parent rating action.
columns.name: parent_rating_date

comment: Credit facility terms as of 30-Sep-2026 (credit memo pack, brief 5.3): one row per facility (active, matured or prepaid) with type, committed limit, drawn balance at the as-of month-end, undrawn, margin, maturity, security type, guarantor type (parent guarantee, keepwell, corporate guarantee, sponsor support, none), the covenant list with the latest-test headroom, the collateral held and, for parent-supported facilities, the support letter from the JP share and the Japanese parent's current rating (Tokyo HO share). Current snapshot: amounts are as of the as-of date (drawn = 0 for facilities no longer outstanding); use is_active = true for the live book. Grain: one row per credit facility (terms as of the as-of date).
